timeline.tweet: A full head and an empty heart is a tragedy.

Good morning, Family. It's a new day. "Lord, I come before you ready to pour out my worries, anxieties, and fears at your feet. I am claiming and declaring Your promises for blessings of peace and strength over my life.

They are different from times when we feel lonely. Feeling sad, bored, and depressed are signs of loneliness. They are signs of one's center, not holding. They are signs of a lack of focus and an active engagement in life. They are signs of self-hatred.
